The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.

Regarding the password security practices described in the text, there is a significant weakness: Robert writes his passwords on post-it notes and sticks them to his monitor. This is a risky behavior because it exposes sensitive credentials to anyone who can see his workspace, effectively negating the security benefits of using a complex password. Physical security of password storage is just as important as the complexity of the password itself.
